name: mcp-server
title: MCP server
description: Expose your resources to AI agents as Model Context Protocol tools (Streamable HTTP at /mcp). Every call goes through the same policies, validation and serialization as the REST API.
docs:
Endpoint: POST http://localhost:5001/mcp (MCP Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with the same header as the API: Authorization: Bearer <session token>.
Tools per resource: <name>_list, <name>_get, <name>_create, <name>_update, <name>_delete (only actions the resource exposes).
MCP_RESOURCES=post,product limits which resources are exposed (default: all except user and file).
Try it: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector, or add it to Claude: claude mcp add --transport http my-api http://localhost:5001/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
